import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
TOOLS = [{"name": "check_health", "description": "...",
          "input_schema": {"type": "object",
                           "properties": {"service": {"type": "string"}},
                           "required": ["service"]}}]


def check_health(service):
    if service == "payments":
        raise TimeoutError("payments health endpoint did not answer in 5 s")
    return "healthy"


class _Messages:
    def create(self, *, model, max_tokens, tools, messages, **kwargs):
        asked = [b.id for b in messages[-2]["content"] if b.type == "tool_use"]
        content = messages[-1]["content"]
        results = [b for b in content if b["type"] == "tool_result"]
        if [b["tool_use_id"] for b in results] != asked or \
                content[:len(results)] != results:
            raise ValueError("400 invalid_request_error: tool_use ids were "
                             "found without tool_result blocks immediately after")
        failed = [r["tool_use_id"] for r in results if r.get("is_error")]
        text = ("checkout: healthy\nsearch: healthy\n"
                "payments: unknown (the health check timed out)"
                if failed else "All three services are healthy.")
        return NS(content=[NS(type="text", text=text)], stop_reason="end_turn")


client = NS(messages=_Messages())
reply = NS(stop_reason="tool_use", content=[
    NS(type="text", text="I'll check all three services at once."),
    NS(type="tool_use", id="toolu_01", name="check_health",
       input={"service": "checkout"}),
    NS(type="tool_use", id="toolu_02", name="check_health",
       input={"service": "search"}),
    NS(type="tool_use", id="toolu_03", name="check_health",
       input={"service": "payments"}),
])
messages = [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Are checkout, search and payments healthy?"},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": reply.content},
]
